notes.title: We're in the running for a nomination for the Outstanding Story Game Award! ~
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyːThe annual Steam Awards have begun, we have witnessed our growth and transformation along the way, and one day we will be eligible to compete for the awards, with mixed feelings, thank you to all the friends who supported us!

ːsteammockingːBecause of everyone's support and recognition, we are still updating the content as of now, but one thing remains the same, that is, the polishing of the plot content and the degree of care in the details.

ːsteamboredːThe plot is the biggest highlight of our game, and it is also the core and most attentive design of the whole game, and the work completed in countless rigorous polishing and common discussions with players, and now we have been recognized by the game, which is the result of everyone's joint efforts, so we will be nominated for the Special Award for Outstanding Story, which is our common honor, please nominate us for the Special Award for Outstanding Plot in the nomination of Steam games!

ːsteamsaltyːThis is a recognition of all our efforts, and it is also an affirmation of our plot, and I am grateful again to all those who are still supporting us! Encourage you ~

notes.title: Update again!This persistence and love is dedicated to my fifty players
notes.content:
There is feedback from players that the backpack reading and the ending bug of the hammer killing home is now fixed!
We have updated the following:
1We've added 20 new Steam achievements, so explore them!
2 We have updated the protagonist's bust drawing, angry and numb
3 We have repaired and adjusted the protagonist's "self-talking" dialogue, as well as the logic of thinking, so that the thinking of his characters is more three-dimensional and organized
Although I don't have many players, our persistence and enthusiasm are full, I wish you all a great time!

notes.title: Long wait, the major update is coming, come and experience it!
notes.content:
A major update up to two months long, here we are anyway! As the first announcement of the game said that we were going to have a major update, and although it was a little late and there were a lot of accidents, we were still done!
We've updated the following:
1 more illustrations, standing drawings, bust drawings
2 more dialogue, logic, plot
3. Text reminders to assist players to reduce frustration
4. Brand new UI interface big update
Come and experience it, thank you for your purchase, this game we have put a lot of effort into and hope to get you to play!
However, there may still be bugs, we are still not enough manpower, welcome to point out the BUG feedback to us, we still have a lot of things that have not been updated, we are eager for your support, suggestions, and help, which will make us go further!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049236/4bd06c4a24604ae070721a641912c8f27b988010.png[/img]

notes.title: Players have needs, we have a response! Always very attentive
notes.content:
[u][b]1. Five in-game art covers have been updated this time, which will change as players delve deeper into key storylines. We hope to give you a little visual enhancement！~ [/b][/u]
[u] This game has strengthened the hints of the game's opening content and the coherence of the plot, ensuring that players can minimize the number of deaths at the beginning, and quickly integrate into the game. The aim is to improve players' retention rate, while weakening the cruel and realistic design. After all, if the game story is written well, players cannot persist in appreciating the subsequent content of the game and feel uncomfortable. However, please rest assured, I still maintain the intensity level of the game plot and strive not to weaken the story experience [/u]

[strike] [i] Due to feedback from many players that the difficulty of the game's opening is too high and the sense of frustration is strong, but I cannot affect the complete plot setting of the game because what is needed is this high setback blow. From a certain perspective, like soul games, there is a threshold for entry. After considering various aspects with friends from ZSJ, we chose to do this [/i] [/strike]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049236/70e380fcca7808141af6845a9c9f6ecf81c6b537.png[/img]

notes.title: Urgently fixed archive bug
notes.content: [u][b]The experience of old players is still stable, but new users have reported that there will be a file reading bug when saving the washing table at the beginning, so fix it immediately! I am very sorry for the bad experience I have brought you. Thank you for your immediate feedback, which has prevented other new player pages from experiencing this bug[/b][/u]

notes.title: Update instructions on May 24, 2023
notes.content:
[b] [u] 1. We have added a comprehensive collection system for guidebooks to the game based on the player's suggestions, and it is not affected by reopening the game or shifting gears, which is very good ̀ ㅂ• ́)و ✧！ Mom, don't worry anymore. I won't be able to collect the entire route. [/u] [/b]

[b] We have optimized the shortcomings in the game: some save points default to save, and players often overwrite old saves when reading files and fast forwarding
Now changed to full archive reminder function, default to no archive [/b]

[i] We have optimized the text of some characters and added subtle colored eggs to the route of the girl character, which only interesting players can discover
We have optimized some of the original plot into routes, and now we can see a total of 24 routes in the guidebook! [/i]

We added a texture [strike] at the end of the game, although there was still some grass growing due to limited abilities
[/strike] [u] We will continue to update and improve in the future. Thank you for playing and looking forward to your sincere comments and comments. Suggestions are also very welcome! [/u]

notes.title: Welcome to your visit and offer my sincerest respect!
notes.content:
[u] [b] Thank you all for meeting me, crossing the vast sea of people and providing me with spiritual strength or practical assistance, all the way to this step today. [/b] [/u]
ːsteamhappyː I am actually very weak and even fragile, but your support has enabled me to shine with the light of life, and has made me brave enough to track my dream in my heart,
ːsteammockingː No matter what the future outcome may be, I will not regret this experience,
ːsteammockingː [u] In two years, four hundred hours, one student, a thousand yuan, a group of netizens, a game, I can't even imagine that I have achieved it~ [/b] [/u]
ːsteamthumbsupː [u] [b] Good news! Our story is not over yet. After the game is launched, more friends will come to help us optimize the game. The plot and art style will be further improved, and we will optimize the work more and more in the future! [/b] [/u]
